description: This file defines a thread-safe, fixed-size circular FIFO queue implementation in Java, called ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue. It provides thread-safe operations to add, remove, and iterate over elements with capacity management and iterator consistency mechanisms.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue with fixed capacity that evicts the oldest element when full. Implements queue operations with internal locking and custom iterator handling.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue.Iterators
classes.description: Manages iterator references and updates to ensure proper iterator behavior in concurrent modifications.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue.Iterator
classes.description: Custom iterator over the circular FIFO queue that handles concurrent modifications and allows safe iteration and removal.

classes.name: ThreadSafeCircularFifoQueue.Iterators.Node
classes.description: Linked list node class for tracking iterators within the queue to handle concurrent modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue, evicting oldest if full.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all elements from a collection into the queue.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the queue.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an element exists in the queue.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements of a collection are in the queue.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns a custom iterator over the queue.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Attempts to add an element to the queue.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it, or null if empty.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue, or null if empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific object from the queue if present.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements in a collection from the queue.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only elements also contained in a specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all elements.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of a specified type with all elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the queue.

methods.name: internalAdd
methods.description: Internal method to add an element, evicting if necessary.

methods.name: internalContains
methods.description: Internal method to check containment.

methods.name: internalRemove
methods.description: Internal method to remove oldest element.

methods.name: internalRemoveAtIndex
methods.description: Removes element at specified index and adjusts pointers.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserialization support, reinitializes lock.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Calculates next index in circular manner.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Calculates previous index in circular manner.
